name: megascenes-trading-card
description: Design a custom trading card with your card name, stats and artwork, from a description or an image in your MegaScenes library.

interface.longDescription:
Name the card, give its stats or powers and describe the artwork: a fantasy creature, a hero, your dog as a legendary card. Or pick a drawing or photo from your MegaScenes library for the artwork.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For game nights, parties, presents and fan projects.

Limitations: original designs only, not cards of existing games or brands; one card per run, as an image. Images must already be in your MegaScenes library. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design a trading card with name, stats and artwork
Use an image from your library as the artwork
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a legendary trading card of a fire dragon with 3000 attack
Turn my latest MegaScenes dog photo into a trading card
Design a fantasy hero card called Storm Knight

positive.prompt: Which models can design a trading card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The trading card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a legendary trading card of a fire dragon called Ember with 3000 attack. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which images could I use as card artwork from my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a legendary trading card of a fire dragon called Ember with 3000 attack. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my trading card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my trading card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
